items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I couldn't sound like George Lewis if I wanted to.

ctx.x: No. Because I never played with any big bands when I was a kid. That's one thing I wish they would have had, a kind of a brass band in Baton Rouge where I could play. And I used to feel a little jealous when... They had a band out of Daumersonville(?), Louisiana, called Clayborn Williams, which was a great band. Old man Clayborn Williams. His son George just died here; he was a good piano player.
